title: Oven Roasted Peruvian Chicken Skewers
description: Tender and flavorful Peruvian chicken skewers roasted to perfection in the oven, featuring sage and a blend of spices, this dish is high in protein and perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, sage, garlic, peruvian aji amarillo pepper paste, lime juice, salt, and black pepper
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through
Remove the skewers from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving
